title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP Basis Consultant who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Technical

Strong knowledge of IT Service Management, SAP Basis and SAP Applications

Hands-on experience with SAP Basis activities, SAP release version upgrades and infrastructure updates for cloud customers

Working experience with SAP HEC, SAP S/4HANA or any other cloud solution.

Hands-on experience with infrastructure operations, network, interfaces and Load Balancer topics related to SAP landscape management (TLO)

Strong technical troubleshooting skills with the ability to form the solution/designing the mechanism for end to end solutioning

Hands on experience in Migration (onpremise to Cloud/Cross cloud/Cross DC's)


Soft Skills

Excellent customer focus / Networking / Relationship Building /Results-driven / Self-organized / Decision making

Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)

Understanding of escalation handling and procedures with customers while proactively working with internal teams towards arriving at a resolution

Experience in working with cross-cultural and cross-functional teams or individuals

Proficiency in English (Written and verbal)


Good to have

Cloud architecture and IT technical infrastructure know-how

Knowledge of/certification in one of Azure, AWS or GCP fundamentals

Experience with Migration, Upgrade projects esp. on S/4H Cloud

Knowledge of Project Management Fundamentals, ITIL, Lean Fundamentals is a plus



What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Childcare assistance

Gympass

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

title: Staff Platform Engineer
description:
Title: Staff Platform Engineer

Business Unit: Process Manufacturing

Location: Brazil, remote

About CAI

CAI is a leading provider of digital work execution platforms designed to enhance operational efficiency and drive productivity in industrial environments. CAI’s platform leverages advanced technology to convert complex, paper-based procedures into streamlined, digital workflows. By enabling real-time data collection and integration, CAI facilitates greater visibility into work processes, allowing organizations to make informed decisions, optimize performance, and ensure compliance.


In addition to robust workflow management capabilities, CAI emphasizes data-driven insights to foster continuous improvement. CAI's solutions are tailored to address the unique challenges of industries such as manufacturing, energy, and pharmaceuticals, helping organizations achieve higher operational standards and reduce costs. With a commitment to innovation and user-centric design, CAI empowers businesses to transition from traditional practices to a modern, digital approach, driving growth and enhancing efficiency.

Come Join the CAI Team

At CAI, we pride ourselves on fostering a vibrant and inclusive culture where collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We believe that working together across diverse teams not only drives innovation but also builds a supportive environment where everyone's contributions are valued. Our commitment to continuous learning and development is central to our ethos; we invest in career development and mentorship opportunities to help our employees thrive and expand their skill sets. With a clear focus on personal and professional growth, we offer a dynamic career path that encourages ambition and rewards dedication, ensuring that each team member has the opportunity to reach their full potential and advance within the organization.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the execution of architecture, development, implementation and quality practices in support of delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform
  • Implementation of cloud platform, operational and architectural patterns and practices to enable key features and drive new feature development
  • Participate in the selection of technology enablers to deliver performant, reliable and cost-optimized solutions
  • Design, build, and maintain cloud platform capabilities, aligned with DevOps and operational practices to rapidly and safely deploy new features to our platform
  • Collaborate with Product, Professional Services, and other stakeholders to develop new cloud-platform features and products
  • Create technical documentation for accessing, integrating, and using Parsable platform capabilities
  • Act as a senior technical team member in the delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform; gain and consistently maintain deep knowledge of our cloud platform and implementation technologies
  • Serve as a senior technical team member and subject matter expert within the platform engineering team and the larger engineering organization
  • Improve and build observability, uptime, and readiness metrics to detect problems and maintain our SLAs with our customers
  • Implement DevSecOps tooling, processes and procedures to promote rapid iteration and reliable delivery of new and updated features
  • Deliver quality work in an agile delivery model within a team environment
  • Share your work and data engineering best practices across the organization

Skills & Qualifications

  • 8+ years experience delivering customer-facing platforms at scale
  • 5+ years experience architecting, building and releasing production-grade within a SaaS environment
  • 5+ years experience developing backend services capabilities leveraging Go and/or Node (Typescript)
  • Demonstrated, hands-on mastery of the AWS suite of tools including Lambda, API Gateway, AppSync, EventBridge, ECS, S3, DynamoDB, DocumentDB, and AuroraDB
  • Deep experience building product capabilities in a microservices architecture
  • Ability to assert and defend opinions on the merits of differing solutions
  • Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

Additional Requirements

  • Experience working in an Agile environment
  • Experience working in a global organization

  • Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

  • Experience working in a global organization

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de Gerente de Engenharia de Software para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas brasileiros. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidade e atribuições:

  • Junto com o CPTO e outro Engineering Manager, contribuir na visão estratégica da área de Engenharia, conciliando com as demandas táticas;
  • Liderar as frentes de Pagamentos e Plataforma;
  • Fazer a gestão das pessoas do time;
  • Ajudar na gestão dos projetos, em demandas de prazos, métricas, etc;
  • Assumir um papel de promotor da cultura da Jusfy;
  • Ser um facilitador e um apoio nas decisões técnicas de Engenharia;
  • Colaborar com a agilidade das entregas e dos times;
  • Ter um papel crítico e analítico do time;
  • Auxiliar na resolução dos problemas da área;
  • Fazendo interface com a área de Produto.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência como gerente de times de engenharia de software em fintechs ou times de pagamentos;
  • Possuir uma visão estratégica da área;
  • Vivência em gestão de projetos;
  • Ter uma boa visão ágil, experiência com MVP;
  • Experiência em gestão de pessoas;
  • Background técnico em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Ser crítico e analítico;
  • Boa capacidade de resolução de problemas;
  • Vivência em empresas de tecnologia.


Diferenciais:

title: Staff Platform Engineer
description:
Title: Staff Platform Engineer

Business Unit: Process Manufacturing

Location: Brazil, remote

About CAI

CAI is a leading provider of digital work execution platforms designed to enhance operational efficiency and drive productivity in industrial environments. CAI’s platform leverages advanced technology to convert complex, paper-based procedures into streamlined, digital workflows. By enabling real-time data collection and integration, CAI facilitates greater visibility into work processes, allowing organizations to make informed decisions, optimize performance, and ensure compliance.


In addition to robust workflow management capabilities, CAI emphasizes data-driven insights to foster continuous improvement. CAI's solutions are tailored to address the unique challenges of industries such as manufacturing, energy, and pharmaceuticals, helping organizations achieve higher operational standards and reduce costs. With a commitment to innovation and user-centric design, CAI empowers businesses to transition from traditional practices to a modern, digital approach, driving growth and enhancing efficiency.

Come Join the CAI Team

At CAI, we pride ourselves on fostering a vibrant and inclusive culture where collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We believe that working together across diverse teams not only drives innovation but also builds a supportive environment where everyone's contributions are valued. Our commitment to continuous learning and development is central to our ethos; we invest in career development and mentorship opportunities to help our employees thrive and expand their skill sets. With a clear focus on personal and professional growth, we offer a dynamic career path that encourages ambition and rewards dedication, ensuring that each team member has the opportunity to reach their full potential and advance within the organization.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the execution of architecture, development, implementation and quality practices in support of delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform
  • Implementation of cloud platform, operational and architectural patterns and practices to enable key features and drive new feature development
  • Participate in the selection of technology enablers to deliver performant, reliable and cost-optimized solutions
  • Design, build, and maintain cloud platform capabilities, aligned with DevOps and operational practices to rapidly and safely deploy new features to our platform
  • Collaborate with Product, Professional Services, and other stakeholders to develop new cloud-platform features and products
  • Create technical documentation for accessing, integrating, and using Parsable platform capabilities
  • Act as a senior technical team member in the delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform; gain and consistently maintain deep knowledge of our cloud platform and implementation technologies
  • Serve as a senior technical team member and subject matter expert within the platform engineering team and the larger engineering organization
  • Improve and build observability, uptime, and readiness metrics to detect problems and maintain our SLAs with our customers
  • Implement DevSecOps tooling, processes and procedures to promote rapid iteration and reliable delivery of new and updated features
  • Deliver quality work in an agile delivery model within a team environment
  • Share your work and data engineering best practices across the organization

Skills & Qualifications

  • 8+ years experience delivering customer-facing platforms at scale
  • 5+ years experience architecting, building and releasing production-grade within a SaaS environment
  • 5+ years experience developing backend services capabilities leveraging Go and/or Node (Typescript)
  • Demonstrated, hands-on mastery of the AWS suite of tools including Lambda, API Gateway, AppSync, EventBridge, ECS, S3, DynamoDB, DocumentDB, and AuroraDB
  • Deep experience building product capabilities in a microservices architecture
  • Ability to assert and defend opinions on the merits of differing solutions
  • Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

Additional Requirements

  • Experience working in an Agile environment
  • Experience working in a global organization

By enabling real-time data collection and integration, CAI facilitates greater visibility into work processes, allowing organizations to make informed decisions, optimize performance, and ensure compliance.


In addition to robust workflow management capabilities, CAI emphasizes data-driven insights to foster continuous improvement. CAI's solutions are tailored to address the unique challenges of industries such as manufacturing, energy, and pharmaceuticals, helping organizations achieve higher operational standards and reduce costs. With a commitment to innovation and user-centric design, CAI empowers businesses to transition from traditional practices to a modern, digital approach, driving growth and enhancing efficiency.

Come Join the CAI Team

At CAI, we pride ourselves on fostering a vibrant and inclusive culture where collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We believe that working together across diverse teams not only drives innovation but also builds a supportive environment where everyone's contributions are valued. Our commitment to continuous learning and development is central to our ethos; we invest in career development and mentorship opportunities to help our employees thrive and expand their skill sets. With a clear focus on personal and professional growth, we offer a dynamic career path that encourages ambition and rewards dedication, ensuring that each team member has the opportunity to reach their full potential and advance within the organization.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the execution of architecture, development, implementation and quality practices in support of delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform
  • Implementation of cloud platform, operational and architectural patterns and practices to enable key features and drive new feature development

  • Serve as a senior technical team member and subject matter expert within the platform engineering team and the larger engineering organization

CAI’s platform leverages advanced technology to convert complex, paper-based procedures into streamlined, digital workflows. By enabling real-time data collection and integration, CAI facilitates greater visibility into work processes, allowing organizations to make informed decisions, optimize performance, and ensure compliance.


In addition to robust workflow management capabilities, CAI emphasizes data-driven insights to foster continuous improvement. CAI's solutions are tailored to address the unique challenges of industries such as manufacturing, energy, and pharmaceuticals, helping organizations achieve higher operational standards and reduce costs. With a commitment to innovation and user-centric design, CAI empowers businesses to transition from traditional practices to a modern, digital approach, driving growth and enhancing efficiency.

Come Join the CAI Team

At CAI, we pride ourselves on fostering a vibrant and inclusive culture where collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We believe that working together across diverse teams not only drives innovation but also builds a supportive environment where everyone's contributions are valued. Our commitment to continuous learning and development is central to our ethos; we invest in career development and mentorship opportunities to help our employees thrive and expand their skill sets. With a clear focus on personal and professional growth, we offer a dynamic career path that encourages ambition and rewards dedication, ensuring that each team member has the opportunity to reach their full potential and advance within the organization.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the execution of architecture, development, implementation and quality practices in support of delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform
  • Implementation of cloud platform, operational and architectural patterns and practices to enable key features and drive new feature development
  • Participate in the selection of technology enablers to deliver performant, reliable and cost-optimized solutions
  • Design, build, and maintain cloud platform capabilities, aligned with DevOps and operational practices to rapidly and safely deploy new features to our platform
  • Collaborate with Product, Professional Services, and other stakeholders to develop new cloud-platform features and products
  • Create technical documentation for accessing, integrating, and using Parsable platform capabilities
  • Act as a senior technical team member in the delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform; gain and consistently maintain deep knowledge of our cloud platform and implementation technologies
  • Serve as a senior technical team member and subject matter expert within the platform engineering team and the larger engineering organization
  • Improve and build observability, uptime, and readiness metrics to detect problems and maintain our SLAs with our customers
  • Implement DevSecOps tooling, processes and procedures to promote rapid iteration and reliable delivery of new and updated features
  • Deliver quality work in an agile delivery model within a team environment
  • Share your work and data engineering best practices across the organization

Skills & Qualifications

  • 8+ years experience delivering customer-facing platforms at scale
  • 5+ years experience architecting, building and releasing production-grade within a SaaS environment
  • 5+ years experience developing backend services capabilities leveraging Go and/or Node (Typescript)
  • Demonstrated, hands-on mastery of the AWS suite of tools including Lambda, API Gateway, AppSync, EventBridge, ECS, S3, DynamoDB, DocumentDB, and AuroraDB
  • Deep experience building product capabilities in a microservices architecture
  • Ability to assert and defend opinions on the merits of differing solutions
  • Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

Additional Requirements

  • Experience working in an Agile environment
  • Experience working in a global organization

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a DevOps Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to infrastructure automation, continuous delivery, observability, and security by collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. The DevOps engineer evaluates emerging technologies, promotes process improvements, and shapes standards and best practices while providing expert guidance to project teams across the organization. This role plays a fundamental role in driving the adoption of cloud platform capabilities in collaboration with software engineering, architecture, and information security teams


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Deploy & Configure AWS Cloud Services;
  • Deploy & Configure Kubernetes resources;
  • Help elaborating or contributing to RFC and ADRs documents describing technical solutions;
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) – Automate infrastructure deployment;
  • CI/CD Pipeline Automation – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions;
  • Observability & Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
  • Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
  • Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.



Essential Skills

  • Experience in a DevOps role, with hands-on AWS experience;
  • Experience with IaC tools, ideally Terraform and Helm Charts;
  • Experience with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools like CircleCI and GithubActions;
  • Experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda, VPC);
  • Knowledge of security best practices for cloud environments;
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills;
  • Familiarity with Ruby or Golang;
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Shell, or Python).



Highly Desirable Skills

  • Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, Zero Trust, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;
  • Monitoring & Observability – Experience using Datadog, CloudWatch;
  • Experience with Kubernetes packet managers (e.g. Helm, Kubectl);
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Analista de suporte de TI
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Responsabilidades

  • Instalar, desinstalar, substituir e configurar equipamentos e softwares.
  • Realizar atividades de logística técnica e suporte presencial nas localidades atendidas.
  • Conduzir site surveys para levantamento de informações e análise de infraestrutura.
  • Organizar, identificar e manter os racks de comunicação de dados em conformidade com padrões técnicos.
  • Realizar suporte e manuseio de equipamentos de rede, como:
  • Firewalls
  • Roteadores
  • Switches
  • Access Points (APs)
  • Garantir a integridade física e funcional dos dispositivos de rede e cabeamento.
  • Identificar falhas, apoiar correções e acompanhar testes de funcionamento.
  • Atuar seguindo procedimentos, padrões técnicos e boas práticas de TI.


Requisitos

  • Conhecimento técnico em hardware e software.
  • Noções de redes de computadores (endereçamento, VLAN, protocolos básicos).
  • Experiência básica com instalação e substituição de equipamentos de TI.
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de especificações técnicas.
  • Habilidade para organizar e manter racks de comunicação de dados.
  • Disponibilidade para deslocamento entre localidades quando necessário.


⭐ Diferenciais

  • Experiência com equipamentos de rede (Firewall, Roteador, Switch, Access Point).
  • Conhecimento em cabeamento estruturado.
  • Vivência com ambientes corporativos e suporte em campo.
  • Cursos técnicos ou certificações iniciais em redes (ex.: CCNA , Network+ , Fundamentos de Redes , etc.).


Atuação Hibrida em horário comercial.


Informações adicionais

O que te oferecemos:


Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Auxílio Creche;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

title: JD Edwards (Financial Consultant)
description:
Business Analyst (Financial)


**Add resumes in English**


• Ensure JDE, Trintech, and other financial applications are compliant with Gallagher’s IT Policy. Build plans to enforce compliance with IT policy and standard user management processes.

• Evaluate SOC reports to ensure vendor and application compliance and surface risks.

Skills

Required:

• Relevant experience working with Financial ERP applications, preferably JDE

• Design and Development Experience with JDE

• Experience working with third party vendors to implement SaaS solutions

• Working "hands-on" knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle and project management methodologies

• Financial acumen (working knowledge) and awareness of key accounting, financial management and analysis processes, including but not limited to General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Fixed Assets, revenue recognition, budgeting, and bank interfaces

• Strong PC skills, including experience using MS Office Products, especially Excel and Project


Requirements:


• Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering or related field

• Relevant experience with technology project support

• Experience with one or for of the following applications: JDE, Trintech Cadency, Workiva, Cognos Analytics, Analytics, OneStream, and Varicent

• Understanding of Single Sign-On and Identity Management solutions

• Advanced level proficiency with Microsoft Office tools including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio

• Intermediate SQL query skills

• Experience working in large enterprises with domestic and international locations

• Experience working with off-shore or remote development/support teams

title: UX Wordpress Elementor / Digital Display Ad & Video Ad / Mobile App Designers
description:
Please only apply if you are really a 'full stack' designer with a variety of seasoned skills incluidng design Elementor Wordpress AND digital display ads that are graphic intensive AND ad video shorts PLUS Bonus for Mobile App design.


Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates passion for UX design with skills ranging from Wordpress Elementor sites & landing pages to ad sets to ad video shorts to mobile app design? Do you have experience working with numerous different design platforms especially in digital form, especially Adobe Creative Suite? Have you made eye-catching animated digital ads? Have you made social media video ads with AI characters like HeyGen and searched for stock video and audio footage based on the sales scripts?


Portfolio of web and digital ad design REQUIRED to be considered for the position.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.


Responsibilities

  • Handle multiple graphic projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by Creative Director.
  • Create UX landing pages on Wordpress with Elementor with provided copy and details set by Creative Director.
  • Create eye-catching display ads with animation on creatopy.com that stimulate visitors from Facebook, Google, etc
  • Create multiple variations of compelling, memorable logos, custom web graphics, web page designs, and digital media ads that reflect critical thinking and design excellence.
  • Stylize the copy provided from our writers into a custom Wordpress page so that it's aesthetically pleasing, professional, unique.
  • Review success of ads and suggest updates and new ads styles.
  • Create Web design layouts, company presentations, brochure, investor decks, infographics, and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of UX design for websites, native and social apps
  • Open to using additional apps such as midjourney.com (unique ai images), creatopy.com (for automated ad sizing), (additional landing page platform, similar to Elementor), capcut, etc.
  • Able to make TikTok and Youtube ad video shorts based on sales scripts with stock video and audio
  • Able to make mobile app designs on Figma


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills and design skills
  • HTML/CSS design
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have excellent grammar skills
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level

Bonuses: Performance and team share bonuses


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your digital media work ranging from ads to web pages.


Requirements Before Employment

  • Short paid test project showcasing landing page, video and digital ads to assess work quality with our spec
  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role: we’re looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing AI team!


About the Role

As an ML Engineer on our team, you will design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models that power autonomous exception resolution, anomaly detection, and explainable insights. You’ll work hands-on with multiple LLM ecosystems like OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Meta LLaMA. You will implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, develop prompt engineering and safety techniques, and integrate memory and explainability into agentic workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models for production.
  • Build RAG pipelines using vector databases and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and MCP.
  • Develop prompt engineering, optimization, and safety techniques for agentic LLM interactions.
  • Collaborate with data engineering to maintain data pipelines for ML workloads.
  • Conduct feature engineering and embeddings generation on structured and unstructured data.
  • Implement model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining pipelines.
  • Explore emerging LLM/SLM architectures and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, data science, product, and engineering teams.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices in ML engineering.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
  • 3+ years building and deploying ML systems.
  • English advance (B2)
  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs/SLMs including fine-tuning, prompt design, and inference optimization.
  • Familiarity with at least two of the following: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta LLaMA.
  • Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and RAG pipelines.
  • Experience working with both structured and unstructured data at scale.
  • Understanding of SQL and distributed data frameworks like Spark or Ray.
  • Deep knowledge of ML lifecycle: data preparation, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, AutoGen).
  • Understanding of AI safety, guardrails, and explainability.
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/LLM solutions on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices including CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.
  • Background in anomaly detection, fraud/risk modeling, or behavioral analytics.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or research publications.


UST is waiting for you!

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Your role and responsabilities:


  • Handling major incidents via CIRS (Critical Issue Response System) and providing frequent updates until resolution.
  • Performing deep-dive application troubleshooting and identifying preventive actions.
  • Managing CIRS-related requests including deployments, feature toggles, and data fixes.
  • Following up on major production incidents and coordinating with cross-functional teams.
  • Enhancing monitoring capabilities using tools like Dynatrace, Kibana, and Splunk .
  • Writing and improving monitoring scripts and alerts based on incident learnings.
  • Handling customer escalations and coordinating with Support & Engineering teams.
  • Supporting planned activities and responding to ad-hoc requests from CES teams.


Requirements and Qualifications:


  • Deep experience in DevOps and Production Support .
  • Experience in automation and CI/CD practices.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, Kibana, Splunk .
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to deep dive into application issues.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills across teams.


Please submit resumé in English.

title: Sap Materials Management Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP MM/DRC- S/4HANA,Remote mode who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Must Have

Functional experience with SAP MM, integration with other application, Brazilian SAP Localization knowledge, NFe knowledge and enhancements to supply processes specially with SAP DRC, Experience with Project, Upgrade, Implementation and Rollout Projects. Experience with SAP DRC inbound.


Good to Have

Experience working with multiple teams in different regions.

Experience with SAP DRC outbound.

SAP S/4HANA Rise experience.

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for work in Blueprint requitements, back to standard on SAP Localization main topics for Brazil, SAP Customizing/Settings, SAP Notes support to Basis and ABAP team, Unit testing execution, Business and User Acceptance testing support, Transition of requirements to customer stakeholders, key users training, Hypercare/stabilization support (+7yrs experience).

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for resolving any SAP issues reported by the business users and delivering all enhancements and upgrade issues as required by business users.

Lead the end-to-end implementation of SAP DRC NF-e projects, including requirement gathering, configuration, testing, and deployment.

Customize and optimize SAP DRC solutions to ensure seamless electronic invoicing (NF-e) compliance in Brazil or other supported jurisdictions.

Ensure accurate integration of SAP DRC with external systems, including government tax portals and legacy systems.

Provide subject matter expertise on local tax regulations and compliance requirements for e-invoicing.

Identify risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies during the project lifecycle.

Conduct user training, support issue resolution, and provide go-live assistance.

Maintain documentation for processes, configurations, and project changes.

Responsible for completing all tasks assigned by team lead and project manager.

Responsible for reviewing solutions designed by the team members and proposing improvements.

Responsible for proactively working with business users for identifying and resolving recurring issues.

Experience in a Professional Consumers and package (CPG) company is an asset.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP MM/DRC- S/4HANA,Remote mode who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Must Have

Functional experience with SAP MM, integration with other application, Brazilian SAP Localization knowledge, NFe knowledge and enhancements to supply processes specially with SAP DRC, Experience with Project, Upgrade, Implementation and Rollout Projects. Experience with SAP DRC inbound.


Good to Have

Experience working with multiple teams in different regions.

Experience with SAP DRC outbound.

SAP S/4HANA Rise experience.

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for work in Blueprint requitements, back to standard on SAP Localization main topics for Brazil, SAP Customizing/Settings, SAP Notes support to Basis and ABAP team, Unit testing execution, Business and User Acceptance testing support, Transition of requirements to customer stakeholders, key users training, Hypercare/stabilization support (+7yrs experience).

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for resolving any SAP issues reported by the business users and delivering all enhancements and upgrade issues as required by business users.

Lead the end-to-end implementation of SAP DRC NF-e projects, including requirement gathering, configuration, testing, and deployment.

Customize and optimize SAP DRC solutions to ensure seamless electronic invoicing (NF-e) compliance in Brazil or other supported jurisdictions.

Ensure accurate integration of SAP DRC with external systems, including government tax portals and legacy systems.

Provide subject matter expertise on local tax regulations and compliance requirements for e-invoicing.

Identify risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies during the project lifecycle.

Conduct user training, support issue resolution, and provide go-live assistance.

Maintain documentation for processes, configurations, and project changes.

Responsible for completing all tasks assigned by team lead and project manager.

Responsible for reviewing solutions designed by the team members and proposing improvements.

Responsible for proactively working with business users for identifying and resolving recurring issues.

Experience in a Professional Consumers and package (CPG) company is an asset.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Your role and responsabilities:


  • Handling major incidents via CIRS (Critical Issue Response System) and providing frequent updates until resolution.
  • Performing deep-dive application troubleshooting and identifying preventive actions.
  • Managing CIRS-related requests including deployments, feature toggles, and data fixes.
  • Following up on major production incidents and coordinating with cross-functional teams.
  • Enhancing monitoring capabilities using tools like Dynatrace, Kibana, and Splunk .
  • Writing and improving monitoring scripts and alerts based on incident learnings.
  • Handling customer escalations and coordinating with Support & Engineering teams.
  • Supporting planned activities and responding to ad-hoc requests from CES teams.


Requirements and Qualifications:


  • Deep experience in DevOps and Production Support .
  • Experience in automation and CI/CD practices.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, Kibana, Splunk .
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to deep dive into application issues.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills across teams.


Please submit resumé in English.

title: UX Wordpress Elementor / Digital Display Ad & Video Ad / Mobile App Designers
description:
Please only apply if you are really a 'full stack' designer with a variety of seasoned skills incluidng design Elementor Wordpress AND digital display ads that are graphic intensive AND ad video shorts PLUS Bonus for Mobile App design.


Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates passion for UX design with skills ranging from Wordpress Elementor sites & landing pages to ad sets to ad video shorts to mobile app design? Do you have experience working with numerous different design platforms especially in digital form, especially Adobe Creative Suite? Have you made eye-catching animated digital ads? Have you made social media video ads with AI characters like HeyGen and searched for stock video and audio footage based on the sales scripts?


Portfolio of web and digital ad design REQUIRED to be considered for the position.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.


Responsibilities

  • Handle multiple graphic projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by Creative Director.
  • Create UX landing pages on Wordpress with Elementor with provided copy and details set by Creative Director.
  • Create eye-catching display ads with animation on creatopy.com that stimulate visitors from Facebook, Google, etc
  • Create multiple variations of compelling, memorable logos, custom web graphics, web page designs, and digital media ads that reflect critical thinking and design excellence.
  • Stylize the copy provided from our writers into a custom Wordpress page so that it's aesthetically pleasing, professional, unique.
  • Review success of ads and suggest updates and new ads styles.
  • Create Web design layouts, company presentations, brochure, investor decks, infographics, and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of UX design for websites, native and social apps
  • Open to using additional apps such as midjourney.com (unique ai images), creatopy.com (for automated ad sizing), (additional landing page platform, similar to Elementor), capcut, etc.
  • Able to make TikTok and Youtube ad video shorts based on sales scripts with stock video and audio
  • Able to make mobile app designs on Figma


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills and design skills
  • HTML/CSS design
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have excellent grammar skills
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level

Bonuses: Performance and team share bonuses


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your digital media work ranging from ads to web pages.


Requirements Before Employment

  • Short paid test project showcasing landing page, video and digital ads to assess work quality with our spec
  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role: we’re looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing AI team!


About the Role

As an ML Engineer on our team, you will design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models that power autonomous exception resolution, anomaly detection, and explainable insights. You’ll work hands-on with multiple LLM ecosystems like OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Meta LLaMA. You will implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, develop prompt engineering and safety techniques, and integrate memory and explainability into agentic workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models for production.
  • Build RAG pipelines using vector databases and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and MCP.
  • Develop prompt engineering, optimization, and safety techniques for agentic LLM interactions.
  • Collaborate with data engineering to maintain data pipelines for ML workloads.
  • Conduct feature engineering and embeddings generation on structured and unstructured data.
  • Implement model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining pipelines.
  • Explore emerging LLM/SLM architectures and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, data science, product, and engineering teams.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices in ML engineering.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
  • 3+ years building and deploying ML systems.
  • English advance (B2)
  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs/SLMs including fine-tuning, prompt design, and inference optimization.
  • Familiarity with at least two of the following: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta LLaMA.
  • Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and RAG pipelines.
  • Experience working with both structured and unstructured data at scale.
  • Understanding of SQL and distributed data frameworks like Spark or Ray.
  • Deep knowledge of ML lifecycle: data preparation, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, AutoGen).
  • Understanding of AI safety, guardrails, and explainability.
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/LLM solutions on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices including CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.
  • Background in anomaly detection, fraud/risk modeling, or behavioral analytics.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or research publications.


UST is waiting for you!

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role: we’re looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing AI team!


About the Role

As an ML Engineer on our team, you will design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models that power autonomous exception resolution, anomaly detection, and explainable insights. You’ll work hands-on with multiple LLM ecosystems like OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Meta LLaMA. You will implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, develop prompt engineering and safety techniques, and integrate memory and explainability into agentic workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models for production.
  • Build RAG pipelines using vector databases and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and MCP.
  • Develop prompt engineering, optimization, and safety techniques for agentic LLM interactions.
  • Collaborate with data engineering to maintain data pipelines for ML workloads.
  • Conduct feature engineering and embeddings generation on structured and unstructured data.
  • Implement model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining pipelines.
  • Explore emerging LLM/SLM architectures and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, data science, product, and engineering teams.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices in ML engineering.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
  • 3+ years building and deploying ML systems.
  • English advance (B2)
  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs/SLMs including fine-tuning, prompt design, and inference optimization.
  • Familiarity with at least two of the following: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta LLaMA.
  • Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and RAG pipelines.
  • Experience working with both structured and unstructured data at scale.
  • Understanding of SQL and distributed data frameworks like Spark or Ray.
  • Deep knowledge of ML lifecycle: data preparation, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, AutoGen).
  • Understanding of AI safety, guardrails, and explainability.
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/LLM solutions on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices including CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.
  • Background in anomaly detection, fraud/risk modeling, or behavioral analytics.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or research publications.


UST is waiting for you!

title: Murex DevOps (CEM) Consultant
description:
Project description

Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade and migration. We provide end-to end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset-classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury and insurance.


Whether you possess a background in finance, technology or Mathematics, your experience in the capital markets industry would be of high interest to us.


Responsibilities


Environment Operations Consultant:

Environment deployment and Management Operations

•Deploy and manage Murex Software needed for Murex client projects using Murex tools and scripts.

•Perform basic smoke tests before delivering the needed products.

•Act as a first-level support for already deployed Murex products, re-directing and following the issues with the corresponding support teams.

•Performing system health checks and diagnostics (RAM, CPU, processes, etc.) to ensure optimal performance and uptime

•Automating routine tasks

Conversion of a customer database

•Perform database sanitization and purging procedures

•Migration sequence execution and stabilization

Setting Methodologies and Procedures

•Contribute to creating the environment and configuration management methodologies, conversion processes, communication workflows, and needed templates and documentation

•Customize and document the installation and the conversion/upgrade procedures

•Deliver needed training and best practices for Murex Clients and project teams

•Manage internal streams: contribute to creating tools, measure related KPIs, and analyze potential issues


Collaboration

•Ensures good collaboration with the project team

•Ensures good collaboration with customer


Capitalization

•Capitalizes on issues not related to a specific client

•Contributes to product evolution (feedback to product teams, follow-up on defects and issues)

Technical Skills

•Degree in Computer Science Engineering or Information Technology Engineering (or related discipline)

•Experience with scripting languages

•Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure

•Strong communication skills

•Knowledge of technical machine specifications

•Knowledge of XML manipulations

•Knowledge of UNIX Operations with hands-on expertise in command-line operations

•Knowledge of RDMS Operations

•Understanding of the Financial markets


Skills must have:

- Strong working knowledge of Murex Configuration and Environment management

- Strong knowledge of scheduler software (e.g. Tidal, Autosys, JAMS, ...etc.)

- Good understanding of MXTest

- Good product knowledge/understanding in IRD, CRD, EQD, FXD

- Good understanding of Workflows, Operations, Fixings process, Confirmations, and Trade Life Cycle

- Strong functional and technical understanding of Murex

- Good knowledge of the different post-trade interactions between the various actors of capital markets including service providers


Must:

- previous experience, min 2yrs, with Murex Environment management

- MXTest Module (a plus)

- Must have strong personality, logical and analytical skills

- Be detailed-oriented, a quick learner and self-starter

- Possess good verbal and written communication skills

- Must have strong organization skills

- Good SQL, Unix , Scripting , Sybase and Oracle skills


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Murex DevOps (CEM) Consultant
description:
Project description

Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade and migration. We provide end-to end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset-classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury and insurance.


Whether you possess a background in finance, technology or Mathematics, your experience in the capital markets industry would be of high interest to us.


Responsibilities


Environment Operations Consultant:

Environment deployment and Management Operations

•Deploy and manage Murex Software needed for Murex client projects using Murex tools and scripts.

•Perform basic smoke tests before delivering the needed products.

•Act as a first-level support for already deployed Murex products, re-directing and following the issues with the corresponding support teams.

•Performing system health checks and diagnostics (RAM, CPU, processes, etc.) to ensure optimal performance and uptime

•Automating routine tasks

Conversion of a customer database

•Perform database sanitization and purging procedures

•Migration sequence execution and stabilization

Setting Methodologies and Procedures

•Contribute to creating the environment and configuration management methodologies, conversion processes, communication workflows, and needed templates and documentation

•Customize and document the installation and the conversion/upgrade procedures

•Deliver needed training and best practices for Murex Clients and project teams

•Manage internal streams: contribute to creating tools, measure related KPIs, and analyze potential issues


Collaboration

•Ensures good collaboration with the project team

•Ensures good collaboration with customer


Capitalization

•Capitalizes on issues not related to a specific client

•Contributes to product evolution (feedback to product teams, follow-up on defects and issues)

Technical Skills

•Degree in Computer Science Engineering or Information Technology Engineering (or related discipline)

•Experience with scripting languages

•Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure

•Strong communication skills

•Knowledge of technical machine specifications

•Knowledge of XML manipulations

•Knowledge of UNIX Operations with hands-on expertise in command-line operations

•Knowledge of RDMS Operations

•Understanding of the Financial markets


Skills must have:

- Strong working knowledge of Murex Configuration and Environment management

- Strong knowledge of scheduler software (e.g. Tidal, Autosys, JAMS, ...etc.)

- Good understanding of MXTest

- Good product knowledge/understanding in IRD, CRD, EQD, FXD

- Good understanding of Workflows, Operations, Fixings process, Confirmations, and Trade Life Cycle

- Strong functional and technical understanding of Murex

- Good knowledge of the different post-trade interactions between the various actors of capital markets including service providers


Must:

- previous experience, min 2yrs, with Murex Environment management

- MXTest Module (a plus)

- Must have strong personality, logical and analytical skills

- Be detailed-oriented, a quick learner and self-starter

- Possess good verbal and written communication skills

- Must have strong organization skills

- Good SQL, Unix , Scripting , Sybase and Oracle skills


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Squad Leader/Scrum Master
description:
Vaga: Scrum Master / Agile Lead


Sobre o Projeto:

O(a) profissional atuará em um projeto de modernização de sistema legado , com foco em coordenar times ágeis durante a migração e reengenharia de sistemas.

A posição exige liderança, organização e visão estratégica para garantir entregas consistentes e alinhadas aos objetivos técnicos e de negócio.


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar squads multidisciplinares durante as fases de modernização e migração do sistema legado.
  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (daily, planning, review e retrospectiva), promovendo engajamento e colaboração entre os times.
  • Monitorar métricas de produtividade, qualidade e entrega , garantindo a transparência e previsibilidade do projeto.
  • Apoiar o Product Owner na gestão do backlog, priorização e remoção de impedimentos.
  • Garantir alinhamento técnico entre as equipes e os Tech Leads/Arquitetos , assegurando coerência entre planejamento e execução.
  • Atuar como agente de melhoria contínua , promovendo boas práticas de agilidade e cultura colaborativa.


Requisitos Técnicos e Experiências:

  • Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master, Agile Coach ou Líder Técnico em ambientes ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão ágil , como Jira, Confluence e similares.
  • Habilidade em liderança, facilitação e resolução de conflitos .
  • Vivência com projetos de modernização ou reengenharia de sistemas , preferencialmente com uso de Strangler Pattern .
  • Desejável experiência como Gerente de Projetos , com conhecimento em metodologias tradicionais (PMBOK) .


Desejável:

  • Certificações em Scrum Master (PSM, CSM) ou Gerenciamento de Projetos (PMP, PMI-ACP) .
  • Experiência em ambientes híbridos , que combinem práticas ágeis e tradicionais.
  • Capacidade de conduzir transições culturais e técnicas em equipes de diferentes níveis de maturidade ágil.

title: Squad Leader/Scrum Master
description:
Vaga: Scrum Master / Agile Lead


Sobre o Projeto:

O(a) profissional atuará em um projeto de modernização de sistema legado , com foco em coordenar times ágeis durante a migração e reengenharia de sistemas.

A posição exige liderança, organização e visão estratégica para garantir entregas consistentes e alinhadas aos objetivos técnicos e de negócio.


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar squads multidisciplinares durante as fases de modernização e migração do sistema legado.
  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (daily, planning, review e retrospectiva), promovendo engajamento e colaboração entre os times.
  • Monitorar métricas de produtividade, qualidade e entrega , garantindo a transparência e previsibilidade do projeto.
  • Apoiar o Product Owner na gestão do backlog, priorização e remoção de impedimentos.
  • Garantir alinhamento técnico entre as equipes e os Tech Leads/Arquitetos , assegurando coerência entre planejamento e execução.
  • Atuar como agente de melhoria contínua , promovendo boas práticas de agilidade e cultura colaborativa.


Requisitos Técnicos e Experiências:

  • Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master, Agile Coach ou Líder Técnico em ambientes ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão ágil , como Jira, Confluence e similares.
  • Habilidade em liderança, facilitação e resolução de conflitos .
  • Vivência com projetos de modernização ou reengenharia de sistemas , preferencialmente com uso de Strangler Pattern .
  • Desejável experiência como Gerente de Projetos , com conhecimento em metodologias tradicionais (PMBOK) .


Desejável:

  • Certificações em Scrum Master (PSM, CSM) ou Gerenciamento de Projetos (PMP, PMI-ACP) .
  • Experiência em ambientes híbridos , que combinem práticas ágeis e tradicionais.
  • Capacidade de conduzir transições culturais e técnicas em equipes de diferentes níveis de maturidade ágil.

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP Basis Consultant who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Technical

Strong knowledge of IT Service Management, SAP Basis and SAP Applications

Hands-on experience with SAP Basis activities, SAP release version upgrades and infrastructure updates for cloud customers

Working experience with SAP HEC, SAP S/4HANA or any other cloud solution.

Hands-on experience with infrastructure operations, network, interfaces and Load Balancer topics related to SAP landscape management (TLO)

Strong technical troubleshooting skills with the ability to form the solution/designing the mechanism for end to end solutioning

Hands on experience in Migration (onpremise to Cloud/Cross cloud/Cross DC's)


Soft Skills

Excellent customer focus / Networking / Relationship Building /Results-driven / Self-organized / Decision making

Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)

Understanding of escalation handling and procedures with customers while proactively working with internal teams towards arriving at a resolution

Experience in working with cross-cultural and cross-functional teams or individuals

Proficiency in English (Written and verbal)


Good to have

Cloud architecture and IT technical infrastructure know-how

Knowledge of/certification in one of Azure, AWS or GCP fundamentals

Experience with Migration, Upgrade projects esp. on S/4H Cloud

Knowledge of Project Management Fundamentals, ITIL, Lean Fundamentals is a plus



What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

title: Staff Platform Engineer
description:
Title: Staff Platform Engineer

Business Unit: Process Manufacturing

Location: Brazil, remote

About CAI

CAI is a leading provider of digital work execution platforms designed to enhance operational efficiency and drive productivity in industrial environments. CAI’s platform leverages advanced technology to convert complex, paper-based procedures into streamlined, digital workflows. By enabling real-time data collection and integration, CAI facilitates greater visibility into work processes, allowing organizations to make informed decisions, optimize performance, and ensure compliance.


In addition to robust workflow management capabilities, CAI emphasizes data-driven insights to foster continuous improvement. CAI's solutions are tailored to address the unique challenges of industries such as manufacturing, energy, and pharmaceuticals, helping organizations achieve higher operational standards and reduce costs. With a commitment to innovation and user-centric design, CAI empowers businesses to transition from traditional practices to a modern, digital approach, driving growth and enhancing efficiency.

Come Join the CAI Team

At CAI, we pride ourselves on fostering a vibrant and inclusive culture where collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We believe that working together across diverse teams not only drives innovation but also builds a supportive environment where everyone's contributions are valued. Our commitment to continuous learning and development is central to our ethos; we invest in career development and mentorship opportunities to help our employees thrive and expand their skill sets. With a clear focus on personal and professional growth, we offer a dynamic career path that encourages ambition and rewards dedication, ensuring that each team member has the opportunity to reach their full potential and advance within the organization.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the execution of architecture, development, implementation and quality practices in support of delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform
  • Implementation of cloud platform, operational and architectural patterns and practices to enable key features and drive new feature development
  • Participate in the selection of technology enablers to deliver performant, reliable and cost-optimized solutions
  • Design, build, and maintain cloud platform capabilities, aligned with DevOps and operational practices to rapidly and safely deploy new features to our platform
  • Collaborate with Product, Professional Services, and other stakeholders to develop new cloud-platform features and products
  • Create technical documentation for accessing, integrating, and using Parsable platform capabilities
  • Act as a senior technical team member in the delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform; gain and consistently maintain deep knowledge of our cloud platform and implementation technologies
  • Serve as a senior technical team member and subject matter expert within the platform engineering team and the larger engineering organization
  • Improve and build observability, uptime, and readiness metrics to detect problems and maintain our SLAs with our customers
  • Implement DevSecOps tooling, processes and procedures to promote rapid iteration and reliable delivery of new and updated features
  • Deliver quality work in an agile delivery model within a team environment
  • Share your work and data engineering best practices across the organization

Skills & Qualifications

  • 8+ years experience delivering customer-facing platforms at scale
  • 5+ years experience architecting, building and releasing production-grade within a SaaS environment
  • 5+ years experience developing backend services capabilities leveraging Go and/or Node (Typescript)
  • Demonstrated, hands-on mastery of the AWS suite of tools including Lambda, API Gateway, AppSync, EventBridge, ECS, S3, DynamoDB, DocumentDB, and AuroraDB
  • Deep experience building product capabilities in a microservices architecture
  • Ability to assert and defend opinions on the merits of differing solutions
  • Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

Additional Requirements

  • Experience working in an Agile environment
  • Experience working in a global organization

Location: Brazil, remote

About CAI

CAI is a leading provider of digital work execution platforms designed to enhance operational efficiency and drive productivity in industrial environments. CAI’s platform leverages advanced technology to convert complex, paper-based procedures into streamlined, digital workflows. By enabling real-time data collection and integration, CAI facilitates greater visibility into work processes, allowing organizations to make informed decisions, optimize performance, and ensure compliance.


In addition to robust workflow management capabilities, CAI emphasizes data-driven insights to foster continuous improvement. CAI's solutions are tailored to address the unique challenges of industries such as manufacturing, energy, and pharmaceuticals, helping organizations achieve higher operational standards and reduce costs. With a commitment to innovation and user-centric design, CAI empowers businesses to transition from traditional practices to a modern, digital approach, driving growth and enhancing efficiency.

  • Act as a senior technical team member in the delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform; gain and consistently maintain deep knowledge of our cloud platform and implementation technologies

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a DevOps Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to infrastructure automation, continuous delivery, observability, and security by collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. The DevOps engineer evaluates emerging technologies, promotes process improvements, and shapes standards and best practices while providing expert guidance to project teams across the organization. This role plays a fundamental role in driving the adoption of cloud platform capabilities in collaboration with software engineering, architecture, and information security teams


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Deploy & Configure AWS Cloud Services;
  • Deploy & Configure Kubernetes resources;
  • Help elaborating or contributing to RFC and ADRs documents describing technical solutions;
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) – Automate infrastructure deployment;
  • CI/CD Pipeline Automation – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions;
  • Observability & Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
  • Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
  • Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.



Essential Skills

  • Experience in a DevOps role, with hands-on AWS experience;
  • Experience with IaC tools, ideally Terraform and Helm Charts;
  • Experience with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools like CircleCI and GithubActions;
  • Experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda, VPC);
  • Knowledge of security best practices for cloud environments;
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills;
  • Familiarity with Ruby or Golang;
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Shell, or Python).



Highly Desirable Skills

  • Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, Zero Trust, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;
  • Monitoring & Observability – Experience using Datadog, CloudWatch;
  • Experience with Kubernetes packet managers (e.g. Helm, Kubectl);
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?

title: JD Edwards (Financial Consultant)
description:
Business Analyst (Financial)


**Add resumes in English**


• Ensure JDE, Trintech, and other financial applications are compliant with Gallagher’s IT Policy. Build plans to enforce compliance with IT policy and standard user management processes.

• Evaluate SOC reports to ensure vendor and application compliance and surface risks.

Skills

Required:

• Relevant experience working with Financial ERP applications, preferably JDE

• Design and Development Experience with JDE

• Experience working with third party vendors to implement SaaS solutions

• Working "hands-on" knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle and project management methodologies

• Financial acumen (working knowledge) and awareness of key accounting, financial management and analysis processes, including but not limited to General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Fixed Assets, revenue recognition, budgeting, and bank interfaces

• Strong PC skills, including experience using MS Office Products, especially Excel and Project


Requirements:


• Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering or related field

• Relevant experience with technology project support

• Experience with one or for of the following applications: JDE, Trintech Cadency, Workiva, Cognos Analytics, Analytics, OneStream, and Varicent

• Understanding of Single Sign-On and Identity Management solutions

• Advanced level proficiency with Microsoft Office tools including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio

• Intermediate SQL query skills

• Experience working in large enterprises with domestic and international locations

• Experience working with off-shore or remote development/support teams
